skill.name: data-engineer
skill.description: Build scalable data pipelines, modern data warehouses, and real-time streaming architectures with Spark, dbt, Airflow, and cloud data platforms.
skill.summary: Designs scalable batch and streaming data platforms with quality, governance, and cost controls.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Data teams need reliable pipelines that scale across batch, streaming, and analytics workloads. This skill guides architecture, orchestration, quality, governance, and cost decisions.
actual_capabilities: Designs batch and streaming data pipelines with source contracts, SLAs, validation, and monitoring.
Compares warehouse, lakehouse, and data lake architectures across major cloud and open source platforms.
Plans orchestration with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, cloud workflow services, and CI/CD practices.
Recommends data quality, lineage, catalog, masking, access control, and governance practices.
Optimizes partitioning, clustering, caching, compression, resource allocation, and cloud cost.
limitations: Does not connect to data sources or deploy infrastructure by itself.
Needs details about volume, latency, storage, governance, and team constraints.
Does not replace security, privacy, or compliance review for regulated data.
Technology recommendations may need validation against current service limits and pricing.

use_cases.title: Plan a Lakehouse Migration
use_cases.description: Compare storage, processing, and governance choices for a staged warehouse-to-lakehouse migration.

use_cases.title: Design dbt Transformation Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan models, tests, lineage, and deployment practices for analytics engineering teams.

use_cases.title: Operate Streaming Pipelines
use_cases.description: Design ingestion, processing, monitoring, and recovery patterns for real-time data systems.

prompt_templates.title: Map a New Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a data pipeline for these sources, destinations, freshness needs, and quality rules: [details]. Include architecture, stages, risks, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Warehouse Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare warehouse, lakehouse, and data lake options for this workload: [details]. Recommend a target architecture with tradeoffs and migration steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Streaming Ingestion
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a streaming ingestion system for [events and scale]. Cover schemas, ordering, retries, storage, processing, observability, and failure recovery.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Enterprise Data Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this data platform design: [summary]. Identify reliability, governance, cost, security, and operational gaps. Prioritize fixes by risk and effort.

output_examples.input: Design a Kafka to BigQuery pipeline for one million events per second.
output: A reference architecture with ingestion, stream processing, storage, schema management, and monitoring layers.
Capacity and reliability considerations for partitioning, backpressure, retries, deduplication, and late events.
Operational recommendations for alerting, lineage, data quality checks, and cost controls.

output_examples.input: Improve data quality for a dbt and Snowflake analytics stack.
output: A testing plan for source freshness, uniqueness, referential integrity, accepted values, and anomaly checks.
A governance approach for ownership, documentation, lineage, and sensitive data handling.
A release process that includes development environments, CI checks, rollback plans, and monitoring.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a planned data mesh for customer and billing domains.
output: Domain ownership boundaries, data product contracts, access controls, and catalog requirements.
Shared platform services for ingestion, transformation, observability, and policy enforcement.
Risks around duplication, inconsistent definitions, governance gaps, and operational ownership.

best_practices: Start with source contracts, SLAs, ownership, and data quality expectations.
Design observability, lineage, and failure recovery before production rollout.
Choose tools based on workload needs, team skills, cost, and operational maturity.
anti_patterns: Choosing tools before defining data volume, latency, quality, and governance needs.
Building pipelines without tests, monitoring, lineage, or rollback plans.
Sending sensitive data through shared systems without masking, access control, or audit logging.

faq.question: Can this skill write production pipeline code?
faq.answer: It can help design and outline implementation steps. Production code still needs review, testing, and environment-specific validation.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, Flink, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, and major cloud data services.

faq.question: Can it help with data governance?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan lineage, cataloging, access controls, masking, retention, and compliance-oriented data handling.

faq.question: Does it require access to my data?
faq.answer: No. You can provide schemas, volumes, constraints, and goals without sharing raw data.

faq.question: Is it useful for streaming systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports event streaming, change data capture, windowing, retries, schema evolution, and real-time monitoring.

faq.question: How should teams use the recommendations?
faq.answer: Use them as architecture guidance, then validate against security policy, budget, service limits, and operational requirements.
